Issue Number: close #35914

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
- Add a poll method named `pollTiFlashPeerInfo` in `ddl_tiflash_api.go`
- `pollTiFlashPeerInfo` will request the PD API `regions/check/down-peer|pending-peer`, Confirm whether the tables(which set TiFlash replicated > 1) can still provide services through the invalid peers(down|pending peers) corresponding to the returned regions.
- If table is unavailable, Then generate a DDL to update the table replicate available.

issue_context.title: Need update TiFlash replica available value when some of regions is down or pending.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
- If some of the regions in TiFlash sync very slow.
- Then in TiFlash, The current peer may report itself as a `down-peer` or a `pending-peer`
- On the TiDB side, it still will see the TiFlash replica available as `true`. So the query may still send to the TiFlash.
- But in this time, lots of regions have not be synced, and The query in TiFlash will got `region timeout error`
